# FG-REVIEW-0021

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_new_name_beyond_the_limit_is_check_run_limit_reached` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このコミットにはこれ以上の種類のチェックを登録できません（上限 100）。既にある名前で報告してください。
- en: No more kinds of checks can be reported on this commit (the limit is 100). Report under a name it already has.
- id: Tidak ada lagi jenis pemeriksaan yang dapat dilaporkan pada commit ini (batasnya 100). Laporkan dengan nama yang sudah ada.

## 原因 (cause)

A check report named a new check on a commit that already holds 100 check runs of reporters in the project (forge_core::MAX_CHECK_RUNS_PER_COMMIT, M3 C1; the names forge reports itself, `forge/spec-drift`, are neither counted nor capped — M3 X2 review — so reads hold at most MAX_STORED_CHECK_RUNS_PER_COMMIT = 101): the cap bounds every read of a commit's runs, the merge gate's included. Reports under a name the commit already has still update their run. Decided under the commit's report lock, so concurrent reports never exceed it. Nothing was written. Not an alert: usually a reporter that puts a run number or a date into the name.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=too_many_runs`, `limit`, `project_id` and `head_sha`, with `action=CheckWrite`. The names on the commit: SELECT name, reported_by, updated_at FROM forge.check_runs WHERE project_id = <project_id> AND head_sha = '<head_sha>' ORDER BY name.

## 対処 (fix)

Report under a stable name per kind of check (for example `ci/gates`, not `ci/gates-<run>`); the details of one run belong in its summary and annotations.
